name: Curse of Thistledown
body:
Curse of Thistledown

School transmutation [air, curse]; Level druid 8, witch 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a handful of dandelion seeds)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets one or more creatures (see text)
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as greater windblown wisp, except that it affects one creature per caster level, no two of which can be more than 60 feet apart. Alternatively, it can be directed at a single creature, in which case the creature is treated as being four size categories smaller for the purpose of weather effects. Remove curse and break enchantment have no effect on curse of thistledown, but limited wish, miracle, and wish do.
